concept: Work  Power Energy, Indian Economic and Human Geography
question:
Select the most appropriate option with respect to the correctness of the following statements.

a) India has great potential for the development of tidal energy.

b) A geothermal energy plant has been commissioned at Manikaran in Himachal Pradesh.

options.text: Both a and b are correct
Both a and b are incorrect

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both a and b are correct**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement a: "India has great potential for the development of tidal energy."**

 
 
• **​****This statement is Correct:**
 
• India **has great potential for tidal energy due to its long coastline of over 7,500 kilometres**, which is exposed to significant tidal movements.
 
• Tidal **energy harnesses the natural rise and fall of ocean tides to generate electricity**.
 
• India has several coastal regions with high tidal ranges, which makes it suitable for developing tidal energy plants.
 
• India’s **vast coastline (with states like Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh)** provides ample opportunity to tap into tidal energy.
 
• The **Gulf of Khambhat in Gujarat and the Sundarbans in West Bengal** are some areas where tidal power potential is high due to the large tidal ranges.
 
 
 
• **Statement b: "A geothermal energy plant has been commissioned at Manikaran in Himachal Pradesh."**
 
 
• ​This statement is Correct:
 
• Manikaran, **located in Himachal Pradesh, is known for its natural hot springs**, which are a result of geothermal activity.
 
• These geothermal resources have been identified as potential sources of energy.
 
• The I**ndian government and researchers have taken steps to harness this geothermal energy for power generation.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**There are several formations of energy.

 
• **Mechanical Energy**

 
 
• Mechanical energy **is the energy possessed by an object due to its motion or position.**
 
• It is the sum of kinetic energy (energy of motion) and potential energy (energy stored due to position or configuration).
 
 
 
• **Sound Energ**y
 
 
• Sound energy is **the energy produced by vibrating objects and propagated through a medium **(such as air, water, or solids) as sound waves.
 
• It is a form of mechanical energy because it results from the motion of particles.
 
 
 
• **Heat Energ**y
 
 
• Heat energy is** the energy that comes from the temperature of matte**r.
 
• It is the energy transferred from one body to another due to a difference in temperature, typically flowing from warmer areas to cooler ones.
 
 
 
• **Other Types of Energy**
 
 
• Tidal Energy
 
• Light Energy
 
• Chemical Energy
 
• Atomic Energy
 
• Nuclear Energy
 
• Electric Energy
 
• Magnetic Energy
 
• Solar Energy
